decisions.reason: As a very recent launch close to the core portfolio and already given its own product page, it has enough strategic and public commitment for management to continue backing it and blame any weak start on normal market ramp-up.

Although the generic antidepressant is more distant from the established offer and therefore less central to the stated direction, the firm has still invested visibly in a 2024 launch so escalation of commitment makes management more likely to persist for at least another year.
This combination antihypertensive fits the existing pharmaceutical business well and has been presented as a standalone product, so recent investment and strategic fit strongly favor continuation.

The supplement appears less heavily committed on the website and would be easier to withdraw, but it supports the firm's push toward differentiated pharmacy health products, which makes management inclined to retain it despite any early uncertainty.
